subject: Request: hotel proximity upgrade for AtlasHealth SF workshop
messages:
From: Sara Varela <sara.varela@atlashealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: hotel proximity upgrade for AtlasHealth SF workshop

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for accommodating AtlasHealth next week — we’re really looking forward to the onsite workshop on Feb 24–25. A quick logistics ask: a couple of our execs (Markus Lindstrom and our Head of Access Ops) will be arriving late on the 23rd and have mobility needs that make a long walk from the standard conference hotel a real hardship. Our travel policy normally limits hotel to the standard corporate rate (~$250/night), but the hotel we booked for the team (conference rate) is ~15–20 minutes away on foot. The hotels immediately adjacent to the venue are closer but run ~$320–$360/night.

Can Redwood approve a proximity upgrade (up to $350/night) for 2 rooms for 2 nights for our execs? We’ll cover any additional incidental charges. I’ve attached the attendee itinerary and the list of impacted guests. If you need a formal PO or purchase order flow, we can loop procurement on our side.

Quick details:
- Rooms: 2 executive rooms, Feb 23–25 (2 nights)
- Max requested rate: $350/night
- Reason: late arrival + mobility accessibility + minimizing transport time for executive sessions

Attachment: Atlas_Itinerary_SF.pdf (PDF)

Appreciate a quick thumbs-up if possible — we need to lock rooms today.

Best,
Sara
Sara Varela

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Folks — forwarding request from AtlasHealth. Client is asking for a proximity upgrade for 2 exec rooms (Feb 23–25). Requested cap $350/night. Total estimated incremental hotel cost (2 rooms x 2 nights) is in the attached estimate (~$200 over corporate rate per night).

Why I’m asking for a quick approval: this is a small deal (D-98732) but high touch exec-level workshop; avoiding a long transfer after a late flight materially improves the workshop schedule and reduces risk of late arrivals.

Options:
- Approve up to $350/night for the two rooms (Redwood books and charges to D-98732)
- Approve but require Atlas to provide PO/CC and Redwood to reimburse / cost-allocate
- Deny and offer travel stipend for taxi/ride-share (less ideal given mobility needs)

Please reply with approval and any spend cap or coding instructions. I’ve attached an expense-estimate.xlsx with quick arithmetic. They need confirmation today to lock rooms.

Attachment: expense-estimate.xlsx (Excel)

— Evelyn

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: hotel proximity upgrade for AtlasHealth SF workshop

Evelyn — approve the proximity upgrade for 2 rooms up to $350/night with conditions:
1) Total incremental hotel spend must not exceed $3,000 for the entire booking (includes taxes/fees).
2) Charge all incremental spend to deal D-98732 and use cost center 4021.
3) AtlasHealth should either provide a PO referencing D-98732 or we require pre-payment via Concur before the incremental portion is charged.

I’m comfortable approving given exec sensitivity and mobility considerations. Please ensure travel is booked via our preferred travel vendor and include a 1-line note in the Concur request saying: “Proximity upgrade approved by Finance — Lauren B.”

Attachment: approval-note.txt (text)

— Lauren

Sara — good news, we can approve the proximity upgrade with the finance conditions below. Thanks for the quick reply on booking flow.

Approved terms (per Lauren):
- Up to $350/night for 2 rooms for Feb 23–25 (2 nights).
- Total incremental spend cap: $3,000 (taxes & fees included).
- Charge to deal D-98732; Atlas to provide PO OR we will require Concur pre-approval for the incremental portion.

Next steps:
- If you want Redwood to handle the booking, please reply with a confirmation that Atlas will accept Redwood billing to D-98732 and upload the PO to the Concur link below. Otherwise, please book with your card and we’ll reimburse per directions above.
